ticket.subject: Re: Moving many tasks at once
ticket.body_text:
Hi Sam Ortega,

Thanks, that worked perfectly. How do I do the same for tasks in archived projects? The checkbox does not show up there.

Cheers,
Mateo

On Sat, 19 Sep 2026 at 11:37, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
> You can move many tasks at once: open the list view, tick the checkbox next
> to each task (or the one in the header to select all), then choose 'Move to
> project' from the actions menu.

> On Fri, 18 Sep 2026 at 10:30, Mateo Ferreira wrote:
>> We are reorganising our projects and need to move about 200 tasks from one
>> project to another. Doing it one by one takes forever. Is there a faster
>> way?

>> On Fri, 18 Sep 2026 at 09:23, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
>>> Thanks for your question, I will check the best way to do this and get back
>>> to you shortly.
